1. Target Audience: 
This movie is best for teenagers, comic book fans, and families with older kids who like superhero stories. People who enjoy action, adventure, and Marvel movies will like it. 

2. Content & Suitability: 
It has comic-book violence, destruction, and scary monsters, but nothing too gory. There is also mild teen romance and some sad moments about grief. It is generally safe for kids aged 13 and up, but parents of younger children should use caution.
